title: Raven's Clockwork Orange
narrativeText: Raven arrives with a shopping cart full of weapons. The crowd has seen extreme matches. They have not seen this. Every weapon has a purpose. Every wound is deliberate. This is not violence for the sake of violence — it is art. Dark, sadistic, perfect art.

choices.label: Execute the Masterpiece
choices.text: Every match is a canvas. Tonight, you paint in red.
